notes.text: Assault Rifles
Assault Rifles have medium penetration, except the SWAT-556, FAL OSW, SCAR-H and SMR, which have high penetration
The AN-94 fires the first two rounds in a burst at an increased fire rate of 937 RPM and kicks 5% less on the first shot
Submachine Guns
SMGs have low penetration
Light Machine Guns
LMGs have high penetration
The HAMR fires the first seven rounds in a burst at an increased fire rate of 937 RPM and kicks 3% less for every shot after the first with a limit of 15%
Sniper Rifles
Sniper Rifles have high penetration
Sniper Rifles without Suppressor have increased upper arm and lower arm multipliers of 1.5, except the SVU-AS
Sniper Rifles with Suppressor have increased upper arm multipliers of 1.5, except the SVU-AS
Shotguns
Shotguns have no penetration, except the KSG, which has medium penetration
The R870 MCS and KSG with Fast Mag reload two shells at a time
Handguns
Handguns have low penetration
Switching to a Handgun uses quick drop and quick raise
The B23R fires the first two rounds in a burst at an increased fire rate of 1250 RPM
Launchers
Launchers have an explosion radius instead of a range
Specials
Switching to the Combat Knife or Ballistic Knife uses quick drop and quick raise
